messages:
alina (People Ops): quick check 1 1: we're changing the 401(k) match tiers effective 2024-09-01 (new tiers: 3%->5% base, 6%->7% top). question: for folks promoted mid-August who hit the new salary band on 8/20, do we apply the new tier retro to 9/1 only, or prorate the match for the partial month?

raj (Comp): good call. policy says match applies based on "active salary as of effective date" so 9/1 should follow new band. if promotion is effective 8/20, they count as the new salary on 9/1, so full new-tier match starting 9/1. no retro to August.

linda (BenefitsVendor): vendor note: we'll need a personnel file with effective dates by 2024-08-25 to ensure import for the 9/1 pay period. missing or late promos will default to old tier.

emily (People Ops): action: ask managers to confirm promotion effective dates by 2024-08-22 so comp can validate and benefits can ingest. i'll draft the note.

sam (IC): follow-up: what about employees who switch from full-time to part-time on 8/15? do we prorate employer HSA contribs and match eligibility?

raj (Comp): part-time rules: HSA employer contribution is pro-rated based on FTE on the first of the month. if FTE < .5 they are not eligible for full employer HSA contribution; match eligibility follows plan rules (1 month of service + active on 1st). for your example, if they move to part-time 8/15, on 9/1 they'll be evaluated at their new FTE and get prorated HSA for September onward.

linda (BenefitsVendor): confirm: we calculate employer HSA contribution as (employee FTE / 1.0) * full contribution and send a prorated amount. payroll needs to receive FTE value in the feed by 2024-08-25.

alina (People Ops): got it. timeline is feeling tight. payroll vendor blackout window is 8/27-8/30 for system maintenance. is that going to interfere?

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll vendor scheduled maintenance 2024-08-27T02:00Z -> 2024-08-30T06:00Z. ingestion and manual updates unavailable during window.

mike (raj): then we need all effective-dates + FTE changes in the HRIS by 2024-08-26 COB to hit the 9/1 processing. otherwise they get the old params and require manual corrections. Linda, does benefits team accept a manual delta file after maintenance?

linda (BenefitsVendor): we can accept a manual delta up to 2024-09-05 for reconciliation, but any manual fixes after payroll posts will be processed as after-the-fact adjustments and may affect taxes. recommend avoiding if possible.

emily (People Ops): draft comms checklist:
1) managers confirm promo/FT->PT effective dates by 2024-08-22
2) HRIS entries must be completed by 2024-08-26 COB
3) benefit/vendor feed deadline 2024-08-25 (earlier than HRIS to allow prechecks)
4) payroll maintenance 8/27-8/30 - no edits during that window
5) reconciliation window until 2024-09-05 (manual delta only)

sam (IC): can we include a one-line FAQ for employees about HSA proration? managers keep forwarding me confused DMs.

alina (People Ops): yes, add this snippet in the email: "HSA employer contributions are prorated based on your FTE on the first of each month; changing to part-time mid-month will affect contributions starting the following month."

emily (People Ops): also adding a short how-to for managers to submit promotions in HRIS (copy/paste):
```
HRIS -> People Actions -> Promotion -> Effective Date -> Compensation change -> Save & Notify Comp
```

raj (Comp): i'll prepare a small validation report to run 8/26 morning and share flagged records by 8/26 noon.

alina (People Ops): perfect. i'll send the manager comms now and set a reminder to follow up on 8/23. thanks everyone :sparkles:
